title: List Virtualization
definition: List virtualization (or windowing) is the technique of rendering only the DOM elements currently visible in the viewport, completely unmounting the elements scrolled out of view. This maintains 60fps even with 100,000 items.
simpleExplanation: If you have a list of 10,000 users, don't draw 10,000 HTML elements. Only draw the 20 that fit on the screen, and rapidly swap the text inside them as the user scrolls.
